measure.name: validate_baseline_heat_recovery
measure.description: Checks that every outdoor-air air loop has exactly one usable air-to-air heat exchanger.
measure.modeler_description: Postcondition for BOSS L200 baselines that request exhaust-air recovery. Counts HeatExchangerAirToAirSensibleAndLatent objects on each AirLoopHVAC outdoor air system and requires a nonzero sensible effectiveness.
